newsitem.title: USA: Applied Microbiology to sell food unit.
newsitem.headline: Applied Microbiology to sell food unit.

text.p: Applied Microbiology Inc said on Tuesday it has signed a non-binding letter of intent to sell its food preservative unit to Burns Philp & Co Ltd for $13.5 million in cash and a $2.5 million loan.
The loan can be forgiven under certain circumstances related to the performance of the food preservative unit, Aplin & Barrett Ltd, over the next three years, it said.
The deal also calls for the return of 2.42 million shares of Applied Microbiology common stock held by Burns Philp, the company said.
The sale is expected to be closed by the end of this year. It is subject to approval by the boards of directors of both companies and the signing of a definitive agreement.

Applied Microbiology said the sale will immediately reduce its revenues and income, but the increase in cash from the transaction will allow it to expand and speed up its marketing and sales program for Cardia, a salt alternative.
